lines.text: While Ezra wept before God's house, Shecaniah proposed a covenant to send away the foreign wives and children.
Ezra made the leaders and all Israel take an oath, then mourned in Jehohanan son of Eliashib's chamber.
Whoever failed to gather in Jerusalem within seven days would lose his property, and Judah and Benjamin's men came.
The assembly proposed that leaders represent everyone, and men with foreign wives come at appointed times with their town's elders and singers.
